wedgeSits.commitLine: "Then it’s set. The old burn east of camp, at sunup. Bring the big pack if you have it."

wedgeSits.name: Nompumelelo
wedgeSits.commitLine: "Out on the road, away from Haven. A dawn meet's not something I can promise while I'm out — when I'm back, find me, and we'll set it then."

wedgeSits.name: Nompumelelo
wedgeSits.commitLine: "Then it’s set. The old burn east of camp, at sunup. Two packs between us."

wedgeSits.name: Nompumelelo

wedgeSits.name: Salvador
wedgeSits.commitLine: "Wait — I'm away from Haven right now, out on the road. I can't promise a dawn meet from out here — find me when I'm back and we'll set it then."

wedgeSits.name: Owen
wedgeSits.commitLine: "Done. The african wild rice patch past the treeline, dawn. Bring a pack."
